title: Enable FileVault disk encryption
summary: Turn on FileVault to encrypt your Mac's startup disk. This protects your data if the Mac is lost or stolen. The process may take some time to complete.

steps.explain: Enable FileVault encryption for the startup disk. You will be asked for your password.
steps.expect: A recovery key will be displayed. Save this key in a safe place.

warnings: Ensure you have a backup of your data before enabling encryption.
You MUST save the recovery key shown in the terminal. If you lose your password and this key, you will lose access to your data.

rollback.explain: Disable FileVault to decrypt the disk. This reverses the encryption.
